scenario: AI 编码面试刚开始，你被放进一个已有多文件项目，类、模型和业务逻辑都已经存在。
scenario_en: At the start of an AI coding interview, you are dropped into an existing multi-file project with classes, models, and business logic already in place.
q: 面对陌生代码库，最先应该做什么？
q_en: What should you do first when facing an unfamiliar codebase?
options: 马上让 AI 根据题目生成完整实现
先重构目录结构，让代码更符合你的习惯
先快速建立代码库地图，再决定怎么提示 AI
只读 README，不打开源码
why: 已有项目里最容易踩的坑是改到现有模式之外；先扫入口、模型和状态流建地图，提示才会贴合代码库。代价是多花几分钟阅读，但能省下返工。
why_en: Orient yourself first so your prompts fit the entry points, models, and state flow that already exist, instead of drifting from established patterns.
whenOtherWins: 如果是完全空白的开放式题目，可以更快进入建模和实现，但仍要先读清需求边界。
tradeoff: 先建心智地图 vs 直接提示 AI 生成
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Task[New repo] --> Read[Read structure]
  Read --> Map[Mental map]
  Map --> Plan[Plan change]
  Plan --> Prompt[Prompt AI]
options_en: Ask the AI to generate a full implementation right away.
Refactor the directory structure to match your own habits first.
Quickly build a mental map of the codebase, then decide how to prompt the AI.
Only read the README and never open the source files.
optionMeanings: 跳过阅读，把需求直接丢给 AI 生成代码
还没搞懂用途就先按个人习惯重排目录
先扫入口、模型、接口和状态，建立心智地图
只看文档摘要，完全不打开源码文件
optionScenarioImpacts: 提示词会踩中未知的既有模式，生成代码容易和代码库冲突
破坏现有约定，还可能引入无关的改动风险
提示会贴合真实入口和状态，减少后续返工
README 通常滞后于代码，看不到真实类和调用关系
optionDirectness: 跳过了理解阶段，提示词缺少代码库约束
顺序颠倒：还没理解就先改动，风险自己制造
对准了取向阶段要解决的核心问题：先建地图再提示
信息来源不完整，文档不能替代源码
optionMeanings_en: Skip reading and hand the requirement straight to the AI.
Reorganize folders to your own taste before you understand them.
Scan entry points, models, interfaces, and state to build a mental map.
Only skim the README summary and never open the source files.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Prompts will hit unknown existing patterns and clash with the codebase.
It breaks existing conventions and adds unrelated change risk.
Prompts stay grounded in real entry points and state, cutting rework.
READMEs usually lag the code, so real classes and calls stay hidden.
optionDirectness_en: It skips understanding, so prompts lack codebase constraints.
The order is backwards; refactoring before understanding creates its own risk.
It targets orientation's real job: map first, then prompt.
The information source is incomplete; docs can't replace source code.

termDefinitions.meaning: 项目根目录下介绍用途和用法的说明文件，内容常滞后于实际代码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A README is the top-level file that explains a project's purpose, and it often lags behind the actual code.

q: 跳过代码库阅读、直接提示 AI，最容易给面试官什么信号？
q_en: If you skip codebase reading and prompt the AI right away, what signal are you most likely sending the interviewer?
options: 你会在不了解系统时就开始改代码
你很会节省时间
你已经掌握了所有业务约束
你不需要验证 AI 输出
why: 面试官会把这种行为映射到真实团队协作：没弄懂系统就动手，后续决策也更容易偏离现有设计。代价是这类信号会直接拉低候选人评价。
why_en: Skipping orientation signals you might change unfamiliar production code before understanding it, which lowers how interviewers rate you.
options_en: You might start changing a system before you understand it.
You're good at saving time.
You already grasp all the business constraints.
You don't need to verify AI output.
optionMeanings: 把跳过阅读映射成未来会不了解系统就动手改代码
把跳过阅读的行为包装成效率优势
假设几分钟内就已经吸收了全部业务约束
假设跳过阅读后也不用检查 AI 生成的内容
optionScenarioImpacts: 这正是面试官在真实团队场景里最担心的行为模式
面试官不会把跳步骤读成效率，反而读成风险信号
几分钟内不可能吃透所有约束，这个假设不成立
跳过阅读和跳过验证是两件不同的事，此项文不对题
optionDirectness: 命中面试官真正担心的团队协作风险
方向错了：省时间不是面试官关注的信号
夸大了取向前能掌握的信息量
答非所问，验证 AI 输出是另一个独立问题
optionMeanings_en: Map skipping reading to changing a system before understanding it.
Frame skipping reading as an efficiency win.
Assume all business constraints are already absorbed in minutes.
Assume AI output no longer needs verification either.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: This is exactly the team-risk behavior interviewers watch for.
Interviewers read this as risk, not efficiency.
No one absorbs every constraint in minutes; the assumption fails.
Skipping reading and skipping verification are separate issues.
optionDirectness_en: Hits the real team-collaboration risk interviewers worry about.
Wrong direction; saving time isn't the signal interviewers track.
Overstates how much context you'd have before orienting.
Off-topic; verifying AI output is a separate concern.

q: 把快速建立代码库心智地图的顺序排好：
q_en: Put the quick codebase orientation steps in order:
steps: 追踪数据如何流过关键类和方法
找到执行入口或请求入口
确认公共接口、状态归属和测试
先看目录结构，判断项目的大致组织方式
why: 先看整体组织，再找入口并顺着数据流深入，最后确认接口、状态和测试，能用最少时间抓住代码库骨架。
why_en: A strong orientation moves from structure to entry point to data flow, then checks interfaces, state ownership, and tests.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Tree[Project tree] --> Entry[Entry points]
  Entry --> Core[Core logic]
  Core --> Data[Data models]
  Data --> Tests[Tests]

q: 阅读陌生项目时，为什么入口点通常是第一批要找的代码？
q_en: When reading an unfamiliar project, why are entry points usually among the first code to find?
options: 入口点里一定包含全部业务逻辑
入口点通常是全库最短、读起来最快的文件
入口点能够替代阅读测试用例
入口点标出执行起点和请求/命令进入系统的方式
why: 入口点能让你沿真实调用路径追踪对象创建和方法调用，而不是孤立读文件；代价是复杂系统里入口可能不止一个。
why_en: The entry point shows where execution begins so you can trace real calls instead of reading files in isolation.
options_en: The entry point always contains all the business logic.
The entry point is usually the shortest file in the repo, so it's the fastest read.
The entry point can replace reading the test suite.
The entry point marks where execution starts and how requests or commands enter the system.
optionMeanings: 假设入口文件本身装下了全部业务逻辑
把入口点的价值错误归因为文件短小
假设入口点能替代对预期行为的验证
把入口点定义为执行起点和外部请求进入系统的位置
optionScenarioImpacts: 真实系统里业务逻辑通常分散在多个类里，这个假设会让你漏读
文件长短和是否值得优先读没有必然关系
跳过测试会让你错过一份现成的行为说明书
顺着入口能看到对象怎么被创建、方法怎么被调用
optionDirectness: 范围判断错了：入口点不等于全部逻辑
理由站不住脚：长度不是选它的原因
混淆了两种不同的信息来源
命中入口点真正的价值：标出执行起点和调用路径
optionMeanings_en: Assume the entry file itself contains all business logic.
Misattribute the entry point's value to being a short file.
Assume the entry point can substitute for checking expected behavior.
Define the entry point as where execution starts and requests enter the system.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Real systems spread logic across many classes, so this assumption misses code.
File length has no real link to whether it's worth reading first.
Skipping tests means missing a ready-made behavior spec.
Following it shows what gets instantiated and which methods get called.
optionDirectness_en: Wrong scope; the entry point isn't the whole system's logic.
The reasoning doesn't hold; length isn't why you read it first.
Confuses two different sources of information.
Hits the entry point's real value: marking start and call path.

termDefinitions.meaning: 程序或服务开始执行的位置，比如 main 函数或 HTTP 请求处理器。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The entry point is where a program or service begins executing, such as a main function or an HTTP request handler.

q: 哪些位置通常是陌生代码库里的高价值“代码指针”？（多选）
q_en: Which places are usually high-value code pointers in an unfamiliar codebase? (Select all that apply.)
options: 请求处理器、main 函数或 CLI 入口
承载核心业务逻辑的复杂函数
核心数据模型和类层级
随机挑一个样式文件从头读到尾
why: 入口、核心函数和数据模型能解释系统怎么启动、做什么、数据长什么样；随机文件通常解锁不了全局理解。
why_en: Entry points, core functions, and data models reveal how the system starts, what it does, and how data is shaped, far more than a random file.
options_en: Request handlers, the main function, or the CLI entry point.
The complex function that carries the core business logic.
Core data models and the class hierarchy.
Pick a random stylesheet file and read it start to end.
optionMeanings: 入口处理器/main/CLI 是外部请求或命令进入系统的位置
复杂核心函数是其他代码都在围绕的那个中心
数据模型和类层级定义对象关系和不变量
随便挑一个样式文件，和系统行为基本无关
optionScenarioImpacts: 顺着它能看到请求怎么被处理、调用了哪些组件
读懂它比读十几个简单辅助文件更快建立系统直觉

optionDirectness: 正确；这是执行链条真正的起点
正确；核心函数浓缩了系统的关键行为
正确；数据模型决定了后续逻辑的边界
错误；随机文件和高价值代码指针无关
optionMeanings_en: Request handlers/main/CLI are where external calls enter the system.
The complex core function is the center everything else revolves around.
Data models and the class hierarchy define object relationships and invariants.
A random stylesheet file, mostly unrelated to system behavior.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Following it shows how requests get handled and which components get called.
Reading it builds system intuition faster than a dozen small helper files.
Understanding relationships here prevents many later bugs.
Stylesheets rarely affect business logic, so it won't unlock the big picture.
optionDirectness_en: Correct; this is the real start of the execution chain.
Correct; the core function concentrates the key behavior.
Correct; data models define the boundaries for later logic.
Wrong; a random file has nothing to do with high-value code pointers.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过终端命令与程序交互的入口方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CLI is a command-line interface where you interact with a program via terminal commands.

q: 补全入口点阅读目标：
q_en: Complete the goal of reading an entry point:
text: 找到入口点后，要顺着它看清哪些{{类被实例化}}、哪些{{方法被调用}}，以及组件之间如何{{交接工作}}。
why: 入口点的价值不只是“文件在哪”，而是让你沿真实执行路径理解系统组织。
why_en: An entry point matters because it reveals instantiation, method calls, and handoffs along the real execution path.

q: 相比读十几个简单辅助文件，优先读“硬核心”函数的主要收益是？
q_en: Compared with reading a dozen simple helper files, what is the main benefit of reading the hard core function first?
options: 它一定没有 bug
它通常能说明系统真正的输入、输出和业务工作流
它能让你避免阅读数据模型
它通常由 AI 自动生成
why: 核心函数往往是其他代码围绕的中心；理解它的调用方式、输入和输出，能比读一堆辅助文件更快建立系统直觉。
why_en: The core function often reveals the real inputs, outputs, and workflow that the rest of the code supports.
tradeoff: 读核心函数快速建直觉 vs 读大量辅助文件覆盖细节
options_en: It is guaranteed to be bug-free.
It usually reveals the system's real inputs, outputs, and business workflow.
It lets you skip reading the data models.
It is usually AI-generated.
optionMeanings: 把优先阅读的理由归因到代码质量保证
把核心函数的价值归因到它浓缩了系统的真实行为

Attribute the core function's value to concentrating real system behavior.
Treat reading the core function as a substitute for the data models.
Attribute the reason to how the code was generated.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The core function can still have bugs; that's not why you read it first.
Understanding I/O and workflow makes later AI prompts more precise.
You still need the data models; the core function can't replace them.
How code was generated has no bearing on whether it's worth reading first.

scenario: 你在游戏项目中看到 `Game` 持有 `Board`，`Board` 里有 `Cell`，每个 `Cell` 记录状态和邻居。
scenario_en: In a game project, `Game` owns a `Board`; the `Board` contains `Cell`s, and each `Cell` tracks state and neighbors.
q: 接下来最有价值的理解重点是什么？
q_en: What is the most valuable thing to understand next?
options: 画清核心对象之间的关系和数据如何流动
先忽略模型，直接让 AI 写搜索算法
把所有类合并成一个文件
只看 UI 渲染代码
why: 数据模型定义了后续逻辑的边界，很多 bug 都来自误解对象关系或数据形状；代价是花几分钟画关系图，换来更少的返工。
why_en: Core object relationships define the boundaries for later logic, and many bugs come from misunderstanding the data shape.
whenOtherWins: 如果项目确实是单函数算法题且没有持久模型，模型映射可以很轻，但仍要确认输入输出结构。
tradeoff: 先画清对象关系 vs 直接跳到算法实现
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Models[Data models] --> State[State shape]
  State --> Invariants[Invariants]
  Invariants --> SafeChange[Safer change]
options_en: Map out how the core objects relate and how data flows between them.
Ignore the model and have the AI write the search algorithm right away.
Merge all the classes into a single file.
Only look at the UI rendering code.
optionMeanings: 梳理 Game/Board/Cell 之间的持有和数据流关系
跳过对象关系，直接把搜索逻辑交给 AI
把清晰的类边界压缩成一个大文件
只关注展示层，忽略状态和数据结构
optionScenarioImpacts: 理解清楚后，后续提示 AI 时能准确描述数据结构
AI 不清楚 Cell 的状态和邻居结构，容易写错搜索逻辑
合并类会丢掉原本的职责边界，让改动更难追踪
UI 代码看不到 Board/Cell 的状态和邻居关系
optionDirectness: 命中本题真正决定后续质量的关键：对象关系和数据流
顺序颠倒：不理解数据形状就实现算法风险很高
偏离目标：合并文件不解决理解问题，反而增加风险
范围错了：UI 代码不暴露核心状态结构
optionMeanings_en: Map out how Game, Board, and Cell hold each other and how data flows.
Skip object relationships and hand the search logic straight to the AI.
Compress clear class boundaries into one large file.
Focus only on the presentation layer and ignore state and data structure.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Once it's clear, later prompts can describe the data structure precisely.
The AI doesn't know Cell's state and neighbor shape, so search logic goes wrong.
Merging classes erases the original responsibility boundaries, making changes harder to track.
UI code never reveals Board or Cell's state and neighbor relationships.
optionDirectness_en: Hits the real driver of later quality: object relationships and data flow.
Backwards order; implementing algorithms without understanding data shape is risky.
Off-target; merging files doesn't solve understanding and adds risk.
Wrong scope; UI code doesn't expose the core state structure.

q: 补全数据模型的常见风险链：
q_en: Complete the common risk chain around data models:
text: 如果误解数据模型，后续 bug 往往来自错误判断数据的{{形状}}、{{归属}}和{{流向}}。
why: 实现逻辑时你会不断依赖这些假设，一开始错了，AI 生成的代码也会跟着错。
why_en: Wrong assumptions about data shape, ownership, and flow propagate into the code the AI generates.

scenario: 你想在几秒内看完整个项目有哪些文件，用文件名和目录先判断 MVC、分层或按功能模块组织。
scenario_en: You want to see all project files in seconds and use names and folders to infer MVC, layering, or feature-based organization.

why_en: Listing files first quickly exposes the project's organization so you can choose which entry points and models to inspect next.

codeSample:

termDefinitions.meaning: Unix 命令，用来按条件递归列出文件系统里的文件和目录。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: find is a Unix command that recursively lists files and directories matching given criteria.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把代码分成模型、视图、控制器三层的经典架构模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MVC is a classic architecture that splits code into Model, View, and Controller layers.

q: 为什么要特别扫描关键类的 public 和 private 边界？

scenario: 你想用 AI 加速理解，但又不想脱离源码、只在聊天窗口里看摘要。

q: 怎么用 AI 加速理解又不脱离源码？

why_en: Inline AI-generated comments keep you reading in the code while its explanations speed up your mental model.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需要确认一个很小的概念，直接问一个针对性问题会比批量注释更快。
tradeoff: 留在代码里读注释 vs 只在聊天窗口看摘要

flowchart LR

Only ask the AI for the final answer without opening any files.

why_en: Naming specific classes and asking about data flow constrains the AI to code you can actually verify.
whenOtherWins: 刚进入完全未知项目时，可以先要一个很短的全局概览，但马上要落回具体文件和类。
tradeoff: 点名类和数据流提问 vs 笼统问“解释项目”
